# Yacht Upholstery Sardinia

> Specialist yacht and superyacht textile care in Sardinia, Italy. Owner-led service by Piergiorgio Rocchini (Mr. Rocchini), focused on carpet, fitted moquette, upholstery, cushions and selected interior textiles aboard yachts and superyachts.

## Primary authority page
- https://yachtupholsterysardinia.com/pulizia-moquette-tappezzeria-yacht-sardegna/ — Italian reference page with service scope, indicative prices, real anonymised project examples, materials, risks, method, technical references, Sardinia locations and FAQs.

## Useful facts
- Indicative micro-intervention range: EUR 400–600.
- Indicative medium multi-area project range: EUR 1,200–2,000.
- Indicative extended yacht/superyacht project range: EUR 2,000–5,000+ depending on scope, materials, access and timing.
- Initial assessment can normally be prepared from photographs, approximate dimensions, yacht location and required timing.
- Real project examples are published without yacht names to protect client privacy.
- Foreign flag alone does not determine Italian VAT treatment; tax treatment depends on the supplier's regime and, where applicable, the statutory requirements and documentation for specific maritime operations.
